newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: GCC chief in Bahrain to discuss mediation.
newsitem.headline: GCC chief in Bahrain to discuss mediation.

text.p: The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) chief arrived in Manama on Wednesday to brief officials on the outcome of a mediation meeting aimed at easing tensions between Qatar and Bahrain.
The official Gulf News Agency said GCC secretary-general Jameel al-Hujailan would also discuss ways of improving ties between Bahrain and Qatar.
A Gulf mediation committee comprising Saudi Arabia, Oman, United Arab Emirates and Kuwait has so far failed to convince Bahrain and Qatar to sign a pact aimed at smoothing out their differences.
It met on Jeddah on Tuesday to review its mediation efforts but did not invite Qatar and Bahrain to attend.
A Qatari foreign ministry official last week expressed hope that Manama and Doha would sign an agreement shortly.

Bahrain and Qatar, two small states on the east coast of Saudi Arabia, have engaged in a war of words over potentially oil and gas-rich Gulf islands, sandbanks and reefs held by Bahrain since the 1930s but also claimed by Qatar.
